2026-11-06-westran-vs-van-far.story: Westran moved on to the Class 1 district final with a 27-8 win over Van-Far. Van-Far's season ends at 1-9. The pre-game projection had Westran by 14 (38-24) with an 85% chance to win. Both defenses held the other side well under its projection.
